title: Choosing a starting point again, clearing labels, and descriptions
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A template that already has sections; a checkbox response label that can be cleared; and the fill screen and Preview.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a starting point cannot be applied twice, or to a template that already has content (offered only on the empty first screen).
2. Clear a response label and confirm publishing is blocked until it is corrected.
3. Confirm no surface the technician sees — the fill screen, and therefore Preview — carries a generated descriptor line summarising a field's configuration (e.g. '4 measurement rows · 3 axles to start · verdict per tire'); an author-written instruction is shown as written.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A starting point cannot be applied twice, or to a template that already has content, because it is offered only on the empty first screen.
  • If a response label is cleared, publishing is blocked until it is corrected.
  • No surface the technician sees (the fill screen, and therefore Preview) carries a generated descriptor line summarising a field's configuration; an author-written instruction is shown as written.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-N1: “A starting point cannot be applied twice, or to a template that already has content, because starting points are offered only on the empty first screen”
  • S12-N2: “If a response label is cleared, publishing is blocked until it is corrected”
  • S12-N3: “No surface the technician sees — the fill screen, and therefore Preview — carries a generated descriptor line summarising a field's configuration. Not "4 measurement rows · 3 axles to start · verdict per tire", nor any variant of it. An instruction the author wrote is a different thing and is shown as written”

Amended on 13 October 2026
S12-N1 says "content" rather than "sections" (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, read on 13 October 2026). The quote above is the current wording; step 1 and the expected results follow it.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
